args.title: Summary: Ironbark Freight Pricing (Main + Companion)
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/freight and its companion piece (https://insights.ironbark.example/freight/companion, registered with lucas.nakamura@northwind.example):

- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices rather than fixed schedules.
- Per the companion piece, shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
